original_request_ref: Current Hermes chat: after New API usage audit, Allen requested fixing (1) Pro controller under-utilizing Flash workers and (2) unreliable/ambiguous subtask dispatch lifecycle.
objective: Provide an opt-in, runtime-enforced Pro-to-Flash dispatch gate and precise Kanban dispatch diagnostics without changing the model roster or enabling live behavior.

AC-1.description: When dual opt-in is enabled, substantial/stateful controller tool calls require a durable worker-terra Flash route or bounded durable exemption; read-only framing remains allowed.

AC-2.description: A route binds assignee worker-terra, model deepseek-v4-flash and provider new-api to the task fields used by _default_spawn; conflicts and route/assignee mismatch fail before write.

AC-3.description: Authorization is isolated per session/turn and derives from durable task/event readback, including exact dispatch_exempted keyword and explicit board.

AC-4.description: Plugin activation uses the supported discovery/PluginContext/invoke_hook path and requires both plugins.enabled and kanban.enforce_dispatch_routing.

AC-5.description: Dispatcher diagnostics distinguish fresh normal wait, expired/no tick, exact capacity wait, exact nonspawnable task, and stale claim using persisted task-level signals.

AC-6.description: Created/ready is never described as running; dispatch uses exact model/provider argv; duplicate idempotency identity does not create duplicate route topology.

AC-7.description: Candidate remains isolated and disabled by default; no live config, service, database, merge, deploy or model roster change occurred.

non_goals: Changing controller default from DeepSeek V4 Pro
Repairing live ruoyu-cost-router catalog variant mismatch
Live activation, gateway restart, merge, deploy, publication or promotion

E-2.command: project-venv pytest tests/hermes_cli/test_kanban_enforcement_integration.py -v as part of E-1
E-2.result: real SQLite route/exemption, explicit-board post hook, and real discover_plugins+invoke_hook dual-opt-in paths passed

E-3.command: tests TestDispatchDecisionSpawnArgv, TestRouteBinding, TestRouteAssigneeMatch, TestDispatchIdempotency in E-1

E-4.result: exact task-level tick classifications and old-schema migration tests passed

E-6.command: git show --check a3a6bbe and artifact SHA-256 generation
E-6.result: commit check clean; digests in artifact_refs

negative_path_evidence.N-1: Known substantial and unknown tools block without route/exemption when enabled; cron/process action-specific read-only vs stateful cases tested.
negative_path_evidence.N-2: Plugin disabled or config gate false produces no blocking hook result; enabled+gate true blocks terminal via real invoke_hook.
negative_path_evidence.N-3: Missing assignee, route/assignee mismatch, explicit model/provider conflict and malformed decision reject before durable write.
negative_path_evidence.N-4: Interleaved sessions cannot share authorization; turn advance/session cleanup expires only the intended state.
negative_path_evidence.N-5: Wrong board, wrong event kind, missing event, forged exemption keyword and mismatched durable task fail authorization.
negative_path_evidence.N-6: Fresh task below two intervals receives no expired-tick diagnostic; aggregate skip for other tasks does not flag current task; exact IDs required.
negative_path_evidence.N-7: Same idempotency key returns one task and one dispatch event; exemption spawn omits model/provider flags.
negative_path_evidence.N-8: Plugin is standalone opt-in and kanban.enforce_dispatch_routing defaults false; live ~/.hermes was not modified.

attack_surface_menu: diagnostic false positives and operator commands
coverage_gaps: No real live Gateway activation or restart was performed; candidate remains isolated.
No full daemon subprocess lifecycle smoke with a real Hermes child binary; _default_spawn argv and dispatcher DB paths are covered by tests.
Live ruoyu-cost-router variant-name mismatch remains a separate blocker for that plugin path and is not repaired here.
Branch is based on a shallow/diverged origin history (ahead/behind); merge/rebase compatibility is not yet assessed.

Worker usage report /tmp/flash_dispatch_v5_usage.json recorded completed=false, failed=false despite process exit 0; controller therefore relied on independent source/test evidence, not worker completion metadata.
